title: Private typed-action structural provenance fixture v3
summary: Replace v2's ambiguous runtime-provenance canary with a pre-ratification, hash-bound deterministic structural-fixture contract whose only possible result is internal conformance of recorded synthetic bytes and relations.
system_thesis: The project may later study agents learning prospectively from lived experience. This proposal does not instantiate or test that thesis. It repairs one infrastructure specification while explicitly deleting all inference from a six-record fixture to actual runtime consumption, production, ordering, dispatch, transition, behavior, memory, or learning.

nodes.before: v2 deferred normative bytes until after purported ratification.
nodes.after: The complete structural fixture contract, schemas, manifests, fixtures, oracle, precedence, test registry, and scope pre-exist and are bound by normative_bundle_manifest SHA-256 6531601d1024729bfccc1bb35d715b047def505c9f3ccddf5b9701e6d1bcf659.
nodes.rationale: Exact-byte ratification cannot precede the bytes it governs.

nodes.before: v2 mixed canonical-envelope language with raw malformed channels and misassigned rejected receipts.
nodes.after: Opaque envelope bytes have one closed extraction interface; accepted and rejected branches have exact six-record schemas, with parser-authored non-dispatch on rejection.
nodes.rationale: Structural conformance needs unique bytes, ownership, and first errors.

nodes.after: Two future source-distinct validators must recompute laws over post-source-freeze generated cases selected from a 2^32 domain.
nodes.rationale: Rule recomputation must succeed on unseen valid and invalid structures.

nodes.before: v2 did not close platform, no-replace, mutation, or receipt recovery semantics.
nodes.after: Future evidence publication is limited to one exact Linux/ext4 contract, collision-safe no-replace publication, explicit crash states, and mutation-detected eligibility.
nodes.rationale: Publication integrity needs one implementable platform and honest threat model.

nodes.before: v2 wording could imply six records proved child calls, parsing, dispatch, transition, score, or syscall order.
nodes.after: Absent. v3 contains no child process or runtime observation; FUTURE_PC_ACTUAL_CONSUMER_PROVENANCE requires a separate live change.
nodes.rationale: Delete an unsupported claim instead of adding theatrical instrumentation.

edges.after: Only unchanged hash-bound normative bytes may define future rendered fixture bytes.
edges.rationale: Prevents implementation from creating the answer after approval.

edges.after: Validators receive candidate bytes and normative laws, never an expected-output table for post-source-freeze cases.
edges.rationale: Makes validation relational rather than membership-based.

edges.after: Only committed agreeing validator outputs may feed the no-replace evidence lifecycle; final eligibility is derived after directory fsync and reopen/revalidation.
edges.rationale: Closes evidence publication without upgrading the underlying claim.

edges.before: Recorded actor labels and order could be read as runtime observations.
edges.after: No edge; actor and ordinal are fixture semantics only.
edges.rationale: A self-consistent artifact cannot establish an unobserved event occurred.

loops.before: v2 requested authority before normative bytes existed.
loops.after: bundle bytes -> independent deliberation -> releasable consensus -> exact human hash/scope ratification -> scoped implementation -> PC1-PC17 -> fresh review -> structural claim only.
loops.trigger: A new explicit instruction may begin intake; this proposal task does not.
writes: future deliberation artifacts only after new instruction
loops.stop_condition: Stop now before architecture_intake init; later stop on any stale byte, unresolved concern, non-releasable consensus, missing human ratification, or scope mismatch.
loops.rationale: Models cannot auto-ratify and downstream tests cannot retroactively approve design bytes.

loops.before: No repaired v3 structural loop exists.
loops.after: After all authority gates, render exact accepted/rejected fixtures, validate independently, generate unseen metamorphic cases after source freeze, compare outputs, and optionally publish only structural evidence on the supported platform.
loops.trigger: Unchanged bundle plus releasable consensus plus exact Rohin ratification of both named hashes.
writes: future structural validation and publication evidence only
loops.stop_condition: Terminate on first mismatch or after PC1-PC17 and fresh review; never emit runtime or scientific conclusions.
loops.rationale: This is deterministic engineering conformance, not an agent or learning loop.

loops.before: v2 described a child stub, parse, dispatch, and transition as a causal runtime lifecycle.
loops.after: Absent from v3. The records are synthetic declared structure, not execution receipts.
loops.stop_condition: Not instantiated; any need for it creates FUTURE_PC_ACTUAL_CONSUMER_PROVENANCE under a new ratified change.
loops.rationale: The narrow structural route is sufficient for this prerequisite and avoids scope explosion.

claims.after: Maximum future claim: under the registered synthetic fixture grammar, accepted and rejected six-record artifacts are internally byte- and relation-consistent with one declared request, response envelope, parse decision, and either one declared pure transition or one parser-authored non-dispatch receipt.
claims.evidence_needed: Unchanged exact bundle and scope, releasable consensus, explicit human ratification, PC0-PC17, complete evidence receipt, and fresh independent review.

claims.before: v2 could be read as establishing actual request consumption, response production, parse/dispatch cardinality, transition, score, or syscall ordering.
claims.after: Forbidden. Actor labels, hashes, ordinal records, and publication evidence establish only internal fixture structure. FUTURE_PC_ACTUAL_CONSUMER_PROVENANCE requires independent runtime observation and a separately ratified change.
claims.evidence_needed: A future live protocol with source-independent observations; no v3 artifact can provide it.

claims.before: A private typed-action artifact might be misread as answer-blind, secret, causal, behavioral, learning, memory, performance, or scaling evidence.
claims.after: Forbidden. The fixture may be answer-bearing and supports no secrecy, model, tool, behavior, learning, memory, comparative, statistical, benchmark, efficiency, scaling, or Experience Models claim.
claims.evidence_needed: Each broader claim requires a new material change, appropriate controls and measurements, exact ratification, and fresh review.

acceptance_tests.setup: Verify the complete pre-existing normative bundle and exact sorted scope, then require Rohin's decision naming both exact hashes.
acceptance_tests.expected: No normative byte is invented after ratification; any changed byte or inferred approval restarts deliberation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Stale, circular, inferred, or pre-byte authorization falsifies authority.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future exact human ratification receipt and bundle/scope hashes.

acceptance_tests.setup: Render the exact accepted and rejected synthetic six-record fixtures.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators independently reproduce all exact bytes and relations.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future golden bytes and dual outputs.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every structural channel binding individually and coordinately.
acceptance_tests.expected: Illegal relations reject at one exact first error and prose never authorizes structure.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any accepted illegal binding falsifies structural provenance.

acceptance_tests.setup: Vary only assistant prose and pair tool-looking prose with empty/malformed tool channels.
acceptance_tests.expected: Parse/transition semantics are invariant to prose; rejected channels have parser-authored non-dispatch.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any prose-derived structural authority falsifies isolation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate state/delta/score variants and record order mutations.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators recompute the declared pure transition and reduced score and reject illegal order/value.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any accepted mismatch falsifies transition conformance.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate missing, duplicate, reordered, extra, cross-fixture, post-close, and recurrence records.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the two exact six-record grammars validate, without a runtime-cardinality inference.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any third structural grammar falsifies totality.

acceptance_tests.setup: On the exact platform, inject crashes around every canary/receipt publication boundary.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only complete reopened/revalidated content-addressed pairs become eligible; partial/stale/mutated objects do not.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any promoted partial or replacement falsifies durability.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future PC6 platform and crash matrix.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate coordinated checksum-repaired valid and invalid alternatives.
acceptance_tests.expected: Semantic laws, not registered whole-file hashes, determine acceptance.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Checksum-only or allowlist behavior falsifies relational validation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise exact and one-over limits plus simultaneous malformed/resource-invalid cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact valid limits accept and over-limits reject without truncation at one first error.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Unchecked or nondeterministic limits falsify the resource contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate every normative, source, platform, fixture, validator, comparator, and receipt identity.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only complete resolvable cross-consistent evidence is eligible.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any stale or circular evidence accepted falsifies the gate.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise success, empty, malformed, duplicate keys/calls, unknown tool, Unicode, pointer failure, and canonical re-encoding.
acceptance_tests.expected: One closed byte extraction and stable first error is independently reproduced.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any ambiguous channel representation falsifies closure.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate rejected event-4 actor, decision binding, booleans, and transition fields.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only STRUCTURAL_PARSER produces NONDISPATCH_DECLARED with no transition identity.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any mock/oracle rejected receipt falsifies ownership.

acceptance_tests.setup: Lint every v3 claim and validate structural extra/reorder cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Text denies actual-runtime inference while exact six-record grammar holds; future runtime gate remains unreachable.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any runtime wording/inference violates the explicit scope retreat.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future PC12 claim lint and cases.

acceptance_tests.expected: All references resolve once and overlapping identities are byte-equal.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any orphan or inconsistent manifest falsifies closure.

acceptance_tests.setup: Test exact-platform match, concurrent writers, collision, symlink/inode substitution, lock crash, directory fsync, and mutation.
acceptance_tests.expected: No replace occurs; mutation is detected; unsupported/excluded conditions cannot pass or broaden the claim.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Ambiguous platform, replacement, or undetected mutation falsifies publication.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future PC14 platform and adversarial outputs.

acceptance_tests.setup: Inject every receipt-side crash, collision, stale, mismatch, replacement, and restart state.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only a directory-fsynced reopened/revalidated pair becomes eligible.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any partial or mismatched eligible receipt falsifies lifecycle closure.

acceptance_tests.setup: Enumerate registered simultaneous invalidities and raw-by-dependent predicate pairs.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators emit one identical earliest error; unavailable dependent predicates are false.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Undefined or divergent precedence falsifies totality.

acceptance_tests.setup: After source freeze derive at least 128 unseen metamorphic cases and audit source for hash branches, tables, and shared helpers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both validators recompute laws on novel valid/invalid cases without allowlisting.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Golden-hash membership or expected-table success falsifies independence.
acceptance_tests.evidence_artifact: Future PC17 source hashes, cases, audit, and outputs.
